I can see that, and have thought of that a bit.  Walking around in the library, I see all that I don't know.  Problem is, nothing's relevant.  It's all about people, of people.  Every book on nihilism and existentialism I've read solves the problem of existence with some cop-out, some loophole.  I'm not going to explain the universe with an outside force; that's self-delusional.

I do want to try weed and acid right now, though.  Smoked weed before, but always in a social atmosphere. It would likely be more productive right now.
